component.name: TokenFlow
component.summary: Local desktop application to track Ollama and DeepSeek usage

description.p: TokenFlow is a local-first desktop companion for Ollama and DeepSeek users. It runs a loopback proxy in front of Ollama, records the token counts reported by the stream, and polls the DeepSeek balance API.
Everything stays local and the DeepSeek API key is kept in the operating system credential store. Telemetry never leaves the machine.

ul.li: Monitor token counts from Ollama conversations in real-time
Watch input, output, and cached token breakdowns
See your 30-day usage patterns at a glance
Monthly calendar heat-map to track your usage for every month
Drill into 24-hour token charts with advanced filtering
Track actual Input/Output tokens and Cache Hit Rate
DeepSeek account balance tracking with interactive trend charts
Everything runs on your machine - no data leaves your desktop
API keys stored securely in your OS keychain
Full offline functionality (DeepSeek balance tracking requires internet)
Tray-anchored metrics panel always at hand
Dashboard with totals, today's streak, and model breakdown
Cross-platform: Linux, Windows, and macOS support
